about: Examples of published sources other than the book that Factorial opens by name: https://factori.al/?example=<name>.
Each is the experiment of the same name in the reference catalogue (process_improve.experiments.reference_catalogue), which holds its
source's citation, where it is printed, and every number the source prints for it; this file holds only what
the page needs to open it. source: the key of the citation. where: where in the source its runs are printed,
as the banner says it. design, model and runs: as web/book-examples.json holds the book's (runs in the order
the source lists them, settings in coded units, the result last). note: shown when the example opens.
tests/web/api/test_published_examples.py checks each against the reference catalogue and the numbers the page shows.

examples.name: ullmann-catalyst-temperature
examples.title: Yield against catalyst A and temperature B, with a centre run
examples.where: Section 3.2, Figure 5 (p. 174); the centre run, pp. 175 to 176 and Table 4 (p. 187)
examples.note: A is the quantity of catalyst and B the reaction temperature in a stirred tank.

examples.name: ullmann-agitator
examples.title: Yield against catalyst A, temperature B and agitator type C
examples.note: C, the agitator type, is categorical: the current one or a new one. With every interaction in the model, no degrees of freedom are left, as in the article, which works with the effects alone.

examples.name: ullmann-agitator-half-fraction
examples.title: Half fraction of the agitator experiment: catalyst A, temperature B, agitator type C
examples.note: Four of the eight runs of the full experiment, chosen with C = A·B: the effect of C cannot be told apart from the interaction of A and B.
